Define paths to data files
```{r}

meta_data_path <- "~/Documents/GitHub/PreclinicalAD_GutMicrobiome_Inflammation/R/Data/Supplementary_table1_metadata.xlsx"

metaphlan_path <- "~/Documents/GitHub/PreclinicalAD_GutMicrobiome-Inflammation/R/Data/PreclinicalAD_metaphlan4_n375_merged.txt"

```

Create phyloseq object
```{r}
abund_threshold=.1 


#mphlan <- data.frame(combined)
mphlan <- data.frame(read.table(metaphlan_path, header = T, sep="\t", skip=1))
print("Done reading metaphlan table")


metadata <- data.frame(read_excel(meta_data_path))
# Convert character coded "NA" to actual NA
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "NA")))

print("Done reading metadata table")

### Processing for phyloseq takes 3 steps 1) species data 2) taxa table 3) metadata
#1) Species Data 
rownames(mphlan)<-mphlan$clade_name
mphlan$clade_name<- NULL
# keep rows with species info
mphlan.species <- mphlan[grepl('s__', rownames(mphlan)), ]
# Drop rows with SGB (species level genome bins)
mphlan.species <- mphlan.species[!grepl('t__', rownames(mphlan.species)), ]

mphlan.species <- as.matrix(mphlan.species)
  

print(dim(mphlan.species))
#2) Taxa table 
# Create phyloseq taxa table
print("Making taxa table")

species <- data.frame(Names = rownames(mphlan.species))
species <- data.frame(do.call('rbind', strsplit(as.character(species$Names),'|', fixed=TRUE)))
rownames(species) <- rownames(mphlan.species )
colnames(species) <- c('Domain', 'Phylum', 'Class', 'Order', 'Family', 'Genus', 'Species')
print(dim(species))
species <- as.matrix(species)
#3) Metadata 
# Filter out samples not found in the metaphlan results and adjust factors
rows_metadata <- rownames(metadata)[(metadata$Sample_ID %in% colnames(mphlan.species))]
metadata <- metadata[rownames(metadata) %in% rows_metadata, ]
metadata <- data.frame(metadata)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample_ID 
# Set categorical variables to factor
metadata[,cat_var] <- lapply(metadata[,cat_var], factor)
# Set numerical variables to numeric
metadata[,num_var] <- lapply(metadata[,num_var], as.numeric)
print(dim(metadata))

print("Differences between metadata rows and metaphlan column names")
print(setdiff(colnames(mphlan.species), rownames(metadata)))

ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(mphlan.species, taxa_are_rows = TRUE), #2083 taxa and 375 samples
               sample_data(metadata),
               tax_table(species)) 
#ps.filt <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps)>.01, ps) #1837 taxa and 375 samples
ps.filt <- filter_taxa(ps, function(x) mean(x) > abund_threshold, TRUE) #177 taxa and 375 samples
ps.filt <- transform_sample_counts(ps.filt, function(x) (x / sum(x))*100)


```


```{r}

## Create phyloseq object
ps_MTG <- ps.filt

mtg_meta <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_MTG))
meta <- read_excel(meta_data_path)

missing_samples <- meta[!meta$Sample_ID %in% mtg_meta$Sample_ID, ]

# Subset phyloseq object to the samples closest to the AD biomarker measure 
## N=198
ps_mtg_single_tp <- phyloseq::subset_samples(ps_MTG, Sample_time == "closest")
ps_mtg_single_tp_meta <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_mtg_single_tp))

```

Figure 1: PCoA analysis
```{r}
# PCoA and permanova using single timepoint samples from healthy and preclinical samples closest to biomarker assessment date 
mtg_single_tp_hp_meta <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_mtg_single_tp))
ps.ordination <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_mtg_single_tp, method='PCoA', distance='bray')
ps.ordination_long <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_MTG, method='PCoA', distance='bray')

coordinates <- data.frame(ps.ordination$vectors)

df <- data.frame(Coord1 = coordinates$Axis.1,
                 Coord2 = coordinates$Axis.2,
                 Age = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "Age"],
                 Sex = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "Sex"],
                 BMI = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "BMI"],
                 Copies_of_APOE4_allele = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "apoe4_carriage"],
                 Diabetes = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "Diabetes"],
                 Hypertension = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "Hypertension"],
                 Days_since_biomarker_assessment = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "Days_since_biomarker_assessment"],
                 Group = mtg_single_tp_hp_meta[, "AD_Status"])
df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Copies_of_APOE4_allele))

axis1.model <- lm(Coord1 ~ Age + Sex + BMI + Copies_of_APOE4_allele + Diabetes + Hypertension + Group, data=df)
axis1_summary <- tidy(axis1.model)
write.csv(axis1_summary, "260818_outputs/260818_PCoA1_hp_LM_results.csv", row.names = T)

# Type III ANOVA to assess the effect of AD_Status on PCoA1 scores while adjusting for covariates
## The effect of AD_Status was marginally significant (F=4.11, p=0.044), indicating that amyloid positivity explained a significant portion of the variation in taxonomic composition along PCoA axis 1. 
axis1_result <- car::Anova(axis1.model, type = 3) 
write.csv(axis1_result, "260818_outputs/260818_PCoA1_hp_typeIII_ANOVA_results.csv", row.names = T)

axis2.model <- lm(Coord2 ~ Age + Sex + BMI + Copies_of_APOE4_allele + Diabetes + Hypertension + Group, data=df)
summary(axis2.model)
axis2_summary <- tidy(axis2.model)
write.csv(axis2_summary, "260818_outputs/260818_PCoA2_hp_LM_results.csv", row.names = T)

axis2_result <- car::Anova(axis2.model, type = 3) 
write.csv(axis2_result, "260818_outputs/260818_PCoA2_hp_typeIII_ANOVA_results.csv", row.names = T)

### Plot PCoA
ordination.plot <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(ps_mtg_single_tp, ps.ordination,
                                             type="samples", color="AD_Status") +
  geom_point(size=1, shape=19) +
  stat_ellipse() +
  scale_color_manual(values=custom_colors_hp, name = "AD Status") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size=14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=14),
    legend.title = element_text(size=14),
    legend.text = element_text(size=14),
    legend.position = "left",
    plot.title = element_text(size=15),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", size = 3)
  )
# Add ggmarginal 
ordination.plot <- ggMarginal(ordination.plot, type = 'boxplot', groupFill = TRUE, size = 10)
ggsave("260818_outputs/260818_PCoA_bray_abund_threshold_0_1.pdf", plot = ordination.plot, bg = "transparent", width = 7, height = 5)

# Add the Unifrac PCoA 1 and 2 axes to the phyloseq object metadata
sample_data(ps_mtg_single_tp)$Tax.PCoA1 <- ps.ordination$vectors[,1]
sample_data(ps_mtg_single_tp)$Tax.PCoA2 <- ps.ordination$vectors[,2]

# PERMANOVA with all significantly different variables based on Table 1
## N = 197 (drops 1 sample without APOE data)
perm_mtg_single_tp_hp <- permanova_wrapper(ps_mtg_single_tp, values=c("Healthy","Preclinical"), dist = "bray", var = "AD_Status", adonis_values = c("Age","Sex","BMI","apoe4_carriage","Diabetes","Hypertension","AD_Status"), ss_method = "margin") #p-value = 0.032
write.csv(perm_mtg_single_tp_hp@permanova, "260818_single_tp_permanova_results.csv", row.names = T)

```

Figure 1: MaAslin2
```{r}
######### Run MaAslin2 and create Fig. 1C ############
ps_mtg_single_tp_filt <- ps_mtg_single_tp

#maaslin_wrapper(ps_MTG, random_effects_vector=c("ID"), reference_vector = c("AD_Status,Healthy", "apoe4_carriage,0", "Sex,M", "Diabetes,0", "Hypertension,0"), fixed_effects_vector = c("Age","Sex","BMI","apoe4_carriage","Diabetes","Hypertension","AD_Status"), anal_method = "LM", core = 8, transf_method="None", norm_method="CLR")

maaslin_wrapper(ps_mtg_single_tp_filt, random_effects_vector=c(), reference_vector = c("AD_Status,Healthy", "apoe4_carriage,0", "Sex,M", "Diabetes,0", "Hypertension,0"), fixed_effects_vector = c("Age","Sex","BMI","apoe4_carriage","Diabetes","Hypertension","AD_Status"),
                abun = 0, prev = 0.1, anal_method = "NEGBIN", core = 8)

num_samples <- length(ps_mtg_single_tp_filt@sam_data$Sample_ID)
sample_cutoff <- num_samples*.15


maaslin_output <- "outputs/261005/261005_maaslin/ps_mtg_single_tp_filt/significant_results.tsv"
  
maaslin_df <- read_tsv(maaslin_output) %>% filter(metadata=="AD_Status") %>% mutate(abs_coef=abs(coef)) %>% mutate(qval = p.adjust(pval, method = 'BH')) %>% filter(N.not.0>sample_cutoff) %>% mutate(feature=gsub(".*s__", "", feature)) %>% mutate(value=as.factor(value)) %>% arrange(desc(coef))


median <- median(maaslin_df$abs_coef)
maaslin_plot_subset <- subset(maaslin_df, N.not.0 > sample_cutoff & abs(coef) > median)
maaslin_plot_subset <- maaslin_plot_subset %>% arrange(desc(coef))
#obtain min and max coefficient values (needed for plotting later)
min <- min(maaslin_plot_subset$coef)
max <- max(maaslin_plot_subset$coef)

### Generate coefficient plot ####
# Calculate 95% CI for coefficients
maaslin_plot_subset <- maaslin_plot_subset %>% mutate(species = fct_reorder(feature, coef))

maaslin_plot_subset$coefmax <- maaslin_plot_subset$coef + maaslin_plot_subset$stderr
maaslin_plot_subset$coefmin <- maaslin_plot_subset$coef - maaslin_plot_subset$stderr

maaslin_plot_subset$CI95upper <- maaslin_plot_subset$coef + 1.96*maaslin_plot_subset$stderr
maaslin_plot_subset$CI95lower <- maaslin_plot_subset$coef - 1.96*maaslin_plot_subset$stderr
write.csv(maaslin_plot_subset, "260818_outputs/260915_Fig1C_coeff_values.csv", row.names = F)

# Plot coefficients
x_min_lim <- (floor(min / 5) * 6) 
x_max_lim <- (ceiling(max / 5) * 6) 
colors_list <- c("#eebe61","#49b9a5")

coeff_p <- ggplot(maaslin_plot_subset, aes(x=coef, y=species, color=as.factor(coef<0)))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmax = CI95upper, xmin = CI95lower), orientation = "y")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype='dotted', color='grey', linewidth=1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values=colors_list)+
  theme_linedraw()+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=18),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=17),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(size=15),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour="black", linewidth=1))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
  xlab('Coefficient')
ggsave("261005_Fig1C_coeff.pdf", plot = coeff_p, bg = "transparent", width = 11, height = 14)

#### Generate prevalence plot ###
### Access species abundance data 
abund <- psmelt(ps_mtg_single_tp_filt)

abund <- abund %>% mutate(OTU=gsub(".*s__", "", OTU))
diff_feat_abund <- subset(abund, OTU %in% maaslin_plot_subset$feature)

# Re-order feature abs abundances according to coefficient value
# This order is preserved in filename, which was previously ordered: 
order <- data.frame(OTU = unique(maaslin_plot_subset$feature))
# sort = F makes sure that the order is based on order_index df which is ordered by coefficient value
abund.df <- merge(order, diff_feat_abund, by="OTU", sort = F)
abund.df$OTU <- as.factor(abund.df$OTU)
abund.df <- abund.df %>% mutate(OTU = fct_relevel(OTU, maaslin_plot_subset$feature))

# For each significant feature in each sample, set AbunNotZero == 1 if its 
# abundance is greater than 0. 
abund.df$AbunNotZero <- 1*(abund.df$Abundance > 0)

# Summarize pathway prevalence by variable of interest
abund.df.n0 <- abund.df %>% 
  group_by(OTU, AD_Status) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), SumNotZero = sum(AbunNotZero)) %>%
  mutate(PercentNotZero = 100*(SumNotZero / N)) %>%
  ungroup()
write.csv(abund.df.n0, "261005_maaslin2_species_prevalence.csv", 
          row.names = F)

prev_p <- ggplot(abund.df.n0, aes(x = AD_Status, y=OTU, fill=PercentNotZero))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette ='RdBu', type='seq', breaks = c(0,50,100), 'Prevalence (%)')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=18, angle=45, hjust=1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size=17),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour="black", size=1))+
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev)
ggsave("261005_Fig1C_prev.pdf", plot = prev_p, bg = "transparent", width = 11, height = 12)

combined_maaslin_p <- coeff_p | prev_p 
ggsave("261005_Fig1B_MaAslin2_taxa_plot.pdf", plot = combined_maaslin_p, bg = "transparent", width = 16, height = 15)


###### Comparing output with Ferreiro et al. 2023 ########
af_results <- read_excel("~/Documents/GitHub/PreclinicalAD_GutMicrobiome_Inflammation/R/Data/Ferreiro_etal_MaAslin2_species_Amyloid_positive_results.xlsx")

af_results2 <- af_results %>% select(feature, coef) %>% dplyr::rename(af_coef = coef) %>% mutate(feature=gsub(".*s__", "", feature))

## Read in our study's significant taxa with a 15% prevalence filter
maaslin_df2 <- read_tsv(maaslin_output) %>% filter(metadata=="AD_Status") %>% mutate(abs_coef=abs(coef)) %>% mutate(qval = p.adjust(pval, method = 'BH')) %>% mutate(feature=gsub(".*s__", "", feature)) %>% mutate(value=as.factor(value)) %>% arrange(desc(coef))

common_results <- merge(maaslin_df2, af_results2, by = "feature", all.x = T) %>% arrange(desc(coef)) %>%
  mutate(consistent = case_when(is.na(coef) | is.na(af_coef) ~ NA_character_,
                                coef > 0 & af_coef > 0 ~ "true_pos",
                                coef < 0 & af_coef < 0 ~ "true_neg",
                                TRUE ~ "false"))
consistent_prop <- common_results %>% count(consistent) %>% mutate(proportion = n / sum(n))

####### Prepare supplementary table 4 #######
maaslin_df_all <- read_tsv(maaslin_output) %>% mutate(abs_coef=abs(coef)) %>% mutate(qval = p.adjust(pval, method = 'BH')) %>% mutate(feature=gsub(".*s__", "", feature)) %>% mutate(value=as.factor(value)) %>% arrange(metadata, desc(coef))

## Add a column that indicates whether the taxa was identified in Ferreiro et al. 2023
maaslin_df_all <- maaslin_df_all %>% mutate(Identified_in_Ferreiro_et_al = ifelse(metadata == "AD_Status", ifelse(is.na(common_results$consistent), FALSE, TRUE), NA_character_))
write.csv(maaslin_df_all, "261005_MaAslin2_taxa_Supplementary_Table4.csv", row.names = F)
```

```{r}
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop')  # Create a summary with sample sizes

options(na.action='na.fail')

  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("q = ", signif(p.value, 2)),

### LMM BH-corrected p-values
p_NGAL_hp <- ggplot(df_single_tp_hp_ngal, aes(x = AD_Status, y = log2_NGAL, fill = AD_Status)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +  # Avoids plotting outliers as points since we'll overlay scatter

  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +  # Adds padding at the bottom
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors_hp) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors_hp) +
  labs(x = "AD Status",
       y = "Log2 Stool NGAL (ug/mL)",
       fill = "AD Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1, size = 16),

        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 50, l = 10)) +  # Increase bottom margin
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")   # Prevents clipping of points at the bottom

y_positions <- df_single_tp_hp_ngal %>%
  group_by(AD_Status) %>%
```

Figure 3: Longitudinal GM compositional stability
```{r}
mtg_bc_matrix <- create_pairwise_beta_div_matrix(ps_obj = ps_MTG,
                                                 distance_metric = "bray",
                                                 distance_metric_string = "BC",
                                                 output_name = "m3_MTG_gt10M_stable_noOther_BC")
mtg_bc_matrix_filt <- mtg_bc_matrix %>%
  filter(Comparison == "Within participant") 

## Only keep pairwse unifrac comparisons from baseline sample
mtg_bc_matrix_baseline <- mtg_bc_matrix_filt %>%
   filter(Time_point.x == 1 | Time_point.y == 1)
# Check which column got the baseline sample. In this case columns y have info 
## on the baseline sample
summary(mtg_bc_matrix_baseline$Time_point.y)

## Select only relevant columns
mtg_bc_matrix_baseline <- mtg_bc_matrix_baseline %>% 
  select(Sample_ID1, Sample_ID2, bray, Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x, Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.y, ID.x, Time_point.x, BMI.x, AD_Status.x, Age.x, Sex.x, apoe4_carriage.x, Diabetes.x, Hypertension.x, ID.y, Time_point.y, BMI.y, AD_Status.y, Age.y, Sex.y, apoe4_carriage.y, Diabetes.y, Hypertension.y) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GM_tax_bc = bray)

summary(mtg_bc_matrix_baseline$Time_point.y) 

# Eliminating rows with NAs
mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset <- mtg_bc_matrix_baseline %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
summary(mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset$AD_Status.y)

# Filter out any consecutive samples that are less than 6 months apart from each other since we are interested in GM changes that happen over longer periods of time
mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset <- mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset %>%
  arrange(ID.y, Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x) %>% 
  group_by(ID.y) %>%
  mutate(
    Time_diff_from_previous_sample_mo = case_when(
      # For the first temporal sample, the previous sample IS the baseline (time = 0)
      # so the diff from previous = diff from baseline
      is.na(lag(Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x)) ~ Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x,
      # For all other samples, subtract the previous sample's time from the current
      TRUE ~ Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x - lag(Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(Time_diff_from_previous_sample_mo >= 6)

summary(mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset$AD_Status.y)
summary(mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset$Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x)

## Time frames more or less match between the two groups
mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_timeframe_hp <- mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset %>%
  group_by(AD_Status.y) %>%
  summarise(
    min_timeframe_mo = min(Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x),
    max_timeframe_mo = max(Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x))

p_long_bc_timediff_hp <- ggplot(mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset, aes(x = Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x, y = GM_tax_bc, color = AD_Status.y, group = ID.y)) +
  geom_point() +  # Add points
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed") +   # Connect points belonging to the same ID +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = AD_Status.y), method = "lm", se = TRUE) +  # Add a linear regression line with confidence intervals
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors_hp) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(mtg_unif_matrix_baseline_subset$Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x), by = 6)) +  # Set x-axis breaks at every 6 months
  labs(x = "Time difference from baseline sample (Months)", 
       y = "GM Dynamism (Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity)",
       color = "AD Status") +  # Label the axes and legend
  theme_minimal() +  # Use a minimal theme for a clean look
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),       # Set general font size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18), # Axis titles font size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),  # Axis labels font size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16), # Legend title font size
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),  # Legend labels font size
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Optional: Add a title with larger font size
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18))
ggsave("261018_MTG_long_bc_timediff_from_baseline_hp.pdf", plot = p_long_unif_timediff_hp,bg = "transparent", width = 10, height = 8)

# Fit mixed-effects model
options(na.action='na.fail')
lmm_hp.interaction <- lmer(GM_tax_bc ~  Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x + Age.y + Sex.y + BMI.y + apoe4_carriage.y + Diabetes.y + Hypertension.y + AD_Status.y + Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x * AD_Status.y + (1 | ID.y), data = mtg_unif_matrix_baseline_subset, REML = FALSE)
library(broom.mixed)
summary(lmm_hp.interaction)
lmm_hp_interaction_lmer <- tidy(lmm_hp.interaction)
write.csv(lmm_hp_interaction_lmer, "261018_MTG_long_hp_bc_dynamism_interaction_lmm.csv", row.names = F)

lmm_hp.null <- lmer(GM_tax_bc ~ Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x + Age.y + Sex.y + BMI.y + apoe4_carriage.y + Diabetes.y + Hypertension.y + (1 | ID.y), data = mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset, REML = FALSE)
summary(lmm_hp.null)

lmm_hp.model <- lmer(GM_tax_bc ~ Time_diff_from_baseline_mo.x + Age.y + Sex.y + BMI.y + apoe4_carriage.y + Diabetes.y + Hypertension.y + AD_Status.y + (1 | ID.y), data = mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset, REML = FALSE)
summary(lmm_hp.model)
lmm_hp_lmer <- tidy(lmm_hp.model)
write.csv(lmm_hp_lmer, "261018_MTG_long_hp_unif_dynamism_lmm.csv", row.names = F)

anova(lmm_hp.null, lmm_hp.model)
write.csv(anova(lmm_hp.null, lmm_hp.model), "261018_MTG_long_hp_bc_dynamism_lmm_anova.csv")

write.csv(mtg_bc_matrix_baseline_subset, "GM_longitudinal_stability_samples.csv", row.names = F)
```

Guild Analysis 
```{r}
library(mEQO)
library(data.table)
set.seed(42)


train_indices <- sample(1:198, size = 0.6 * 198)
meta <- sample_data(ps_mtg_single_tp) %>% as.data.frame()
meta$train_test <- "test"
meta$train_test[train_indices] <- "train"
sample_data(ps_mtg_single_tp) <- sample_data(meta)
ps_mtg_single_tp_train <- ps_mtg_single_tp %>% ps_filter(train_test == "train")

Nmax    <- 10
maxIter <- 200

M <- t(as(otu_table(ps_mtg_single_tp_train), "matrix"))

sd <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_mtg_single_tp_train), check.names = FALSE)
AD_Status <- factor(sd[rownames(M), "AD_Status"])

Y <- sapply(levels(AD_Status), function(l) as.numeric(AD_Status == l))
rownames(Y) <- rownames(M)
 
guild <- EQO_ga("d", M, Y, Nmax = Nmax, maxIter = maxIter, monitor = FALSE)
 
guild$members       # taxa in the guild
guild$performance   
guild_abundance <- setNames(guild$abundance, rownames(M))
print(tapply(guild_abundance, AD_Status, summary))
 


```

Adding guild data to ps object and preparing split for ML
```{r}

###### Add to guild 

for (species_name in guild$members) {
  if (species_name %in% taxa_names(ps_MTG)) {
    species_abundance <- as.vector(otu_table(ps_MTG)[species_name, ]) 
    sample_data(ps_MTG)[[paste0(species_name, "_abundance")]] <- species_abundance
  } else {
    warning(paste("Species", species_name, "not found in phyloseq object"))
  }
}

# guild abundance = sum of the taxon columns just added
added_cols <- paste0(intersect(guild$members, taxa_names(ps_MTG)), "_abundance")
sample_data(ps_MTG)$guild_abundance <- rowSums(
  data.frame(sample_data(ps_MTG), check.names = FALSE)[, added_cols, drop = FALSE]
)

# carry each subject's split to all of its samples in ps
meta_ps   <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_MTG), check.names = FALSE)
split_id  <- meta$train_test[match(meta_ps$ID, meta$ID)]          # subject's split
in_single <- meta_ps$Sample_ID %in% meta$Sample_ID                # the single-tp sample itself
meta_ps$train_test <- ifelse(in_single, split_id, paste0("long_", split_id))
meta_ps$train_test[is.na(split_id)] <- NA                         # subject not in single tp
sample_data(ps_MTG) <- sample_data(meta_ps)

table(meta_ps$train_test, useNA = "ifany")
```

Run Random Forest Models
```{r}
library(caret)          # method = "rf" uses the randomForest package
library(VIM)            # kNN imputation, as in the reference script
 
# kNN imputation of sample_data variables, done once before any model is run,
# as in dantaslab/preclinAD_GutMicrobiomes (legacy): VIM::kNN with its defaults
# (k = 5), all used samples imputed together, outcome included in the distance.
# Every model then sees the same imputed values.
#
# ps        phyloseq object with a train_test column
# vars      sample_data variables to impute; also the variables kNN uses to find
#           neighbours (plus the outcome). Use the union of all model features.
# use       which train_test groups to impute. long_test is left out by default
#           because run_rf() never uses it.
#
# Returns ps with the imputed values written into sample_data, and a message
# with per-variable counts.
impute_ps <- function(ps, vars, outcome = "AD_Status", split_col = "train_test",
                      use = c("train", "test", "long_train"), seed = 42) {
  sd <- data.frame(sample_data(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  not_found <- setdiff(c(vars, outcome, split_col), names(sd))
  if (length(not_found)) stop("Not in sample_data: ", paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))
 
  rows <- which(sd[[split_col]] %in% use)
  rows <- rows[order(rownames(sd)[rows])]              # fixed order, independent of ps
  stopifnot(!anyNA(sd[rows, outcome]))                 # the outcome is never imputed
 
  n_na <- colSums(is.na(sd[rows, vars, drop = FALSE]))
  if (!any(n_na > 0)) {
    message("No missing values to impute")
    return(ps)
  }
 
  set.seed(seed)                                       # kNN breaks categorical ties at random
  imp <- VIM::kNN(data.frame(sd[rows, vars, drop = FALSE], .outcome = factor(sd[rows, outcome]),
                             check.names = FALSE),
                  imp_var = FALSE)
  sd[rows, vars] <- imp[, seq_along(vars)]             # drop the outcome column again
  sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(sd)
 
  n_na <- n_na[n_na > 0]
  message(sprintf("Imputed %d values across %d samples (kNN, k = 5, joint) -- %s",
                  sum(n_na), length(rows),
                  paste(sprintf("%s: %d", names(n_na), n_na), collapse = ", ")))
  ps
}
 

run_rf <- function(ps, features, model_name, positive, use_long = FALSE,
                   outcome = "AD_Status", id_col = "ID", split_col = "train_test",
                   n_iter = 100, p = 0.8, seed = 42, sampling = "down", n_cores = 8,
                   cv_folds = 10) {
 
  sd  <- data.frame(sample_data(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
 
  cols_missing <- setdiff(c(outcome, id_col, split_col), names(sd))
  if (length(cols_missing)) stop("Column(s) not in sample_data: ", paste(cols_missing, collapse = ", "),
                                 " (check outcome / id_col / split_col)")
 
  # predictors: sample_data columns first, anything else from the taxa table
  not_found <- setdiff(features, c(names(sd), colnames(otu)))
  if (length(not_found)) stop("Not in sample_data or taxa: ", paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))
  from_sd <- intersect(features, names(sd))
  X <- data.frame(sd[, from_sd, drop = FALSE],
                  otu[rownames(sd), setdiff(features, from_sd), drop = FALSE],
                  check.names = FALSE)[, features, drop = FALSE]
  X[] <- lapply(X, function(v) if (is.character(v)) factor(v) else v)   # text -> categorical
 
  # fixed sample order, so results don't depend on how ps happens to be sorted
  ord   <- order(rownames(sd))
  X     <- X[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  y     <- factor(sd[ord, outcome])
  ids   <- as.character(sd[ord, id_col])
  split <- sd[ord, split_col]
  stopifnot(nlevels(y) == 2, positive %in% levels(y))
 
  pool <- which(split %in% c("train", if (use_long) "long_train"))
  test <- which(split %in% "test")
  stopifnot(!any(ids[test] %in% ids[pool]),            # no subject in both sets
            !anyNA(y[c(pool, test)]))                  # the outcome is never imputed
 
  na_feat <- colSums(is.na(X[c(pool, test), , drop = FALSE]))
  if (any(na_feat > 0)) {
    stop("Missing values in: ", paste(names(na_feat)[na_feat > 0], collapse = ", "),
         " -- run impute_ps() first")
  }
 
  ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = cv_folds, allowParallel = FALSE,
                       sampling = sampling)
 
  # iterations run in parallel when n_cores > 1 (forked processes; macOS/Linux).
  # Each iteration sets its own seed, so results are identical for any n_cores.
  res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(n_iter), mc.cores = n_cores, FUN = function(i) {
    set.seed(seed + i)
 
    # one sample per subject (only matters when long_train samples are included)
    tr <- unlist(lapply(split(pool, ids[pool]), function(k) k[sample.int(length(k), 1)]))
    tr <- tr[createDataPartition(y[tr], p = p, list = FALSE)]
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ids[tr]))
 
    fit  <- train(x = X[tr, , drop = FALSE], y = y[tr], method = "rf",
                  metric = "Accuracy", trControl = ctrl)
    pred <- predict(fit, X[test, , drop = FALSE])
 
    truth <- y[test] == positive
    called <- pred == positive
    tp <- sum(called & truth);  tn <- sum(!called & !truth)
    fp <- sum(called & !truth); fn <- sum(!called & truth)
 
    # = varImp(fit, scale = FALSE), but keeps feature names when there is only one
    imp <- randomForest::importance(fit$finalModel)[features, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
 
    list(
      metrics = data.frame(model     = model_name,
                           iteration = i,
                           accuracy  = (tp + tn) / length(test),
                           f1        = 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn),
                           sens      = tp / (tp + fn),
                           spec      = tn / (tn + fp),
                           mcc       = (tp * tn - fp * fn) /
                                       sqrt(as.numeric(tp + fp) * (tp + fn) * (tn + fp) * (tn + fn))),
      importance = data.frame(model = model_name, iteration = i,
                              t(setNames(imp, features)),
                              check.names = FALSE)
    )
  })
  failed <- vapply(res, inherits, logical(1), "try-error")   # errors in workers come back as values
  if (any(failed)) stop("Iteration ", which(failed)[1], " failed: ", res[[which(failed)[1]]])
  list(metrics    = do.call(rbind, lapply(res, `[[`, "metrics")),
       importance = do.call(rbind, lapply(res, `[[`, "importance")))
}
features <- c("Years_Education", "Age", "Diabetes", "Hypertension", "Sex", "BMI",
              "apoe4_carriage", "log2_Calp", "log2_NGAL",  "guild_abundance",
              "hippocampus_vol_div_icv",
              "LOAD_CorticalSignature_Thickness", "mr_vol_tot_wmhypointensities")

ps_MTG_imputed <- impute_ps(ps_MTG, vars=features)

run_rf <- function(ps, features, model_name, positive, use_long = FALSE,
                   outcome = "AD_Status", id_col = "ID", split_col = "train_test",
                   n_iter = 100, p = 0.8, seed = 42, sampling = "down", n_cores = 8,
                   cv_folds = 10) {
 
  sd  <- data.frame(sample_data(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
 
  cols_missing <- setdiff(c(outcome, id_col, split_col), names(sd))
  if (length(cols_missing)) stop("Column(s) not in sample_data: ", paste(cols_missing, collapse = ", "),
                                 " (check outcome / id_col / split_col)")
 
  # predictors: sample_data columns first, anything else from the taxa table
  not_found <- setdiff(features, c(names(sd), colnames(otu)))
  if (length(not_found)) stop("Not in sample_data or taxa: ", paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))
  from_sd <- intersect(features, names(sd))
  X <- data.frame(sd[, from_sd, drop = FALSE],
                  otu[rownames(sd), setdiff(features, from_sd), drop = FALSE],
                  check.names = FALSE)[, features, drop = FALSE]
  X[] <- lapply(X, function(v) if (is.character(v)) factor(v) else v)   # text -> categorical
 
  # fixed sample order, so results don't depend on how ps happens to be sorted
  ord   <- order(rownames(sd))
  X     <- X[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  y     <- factor(sd[ord, outcome])
  ids   <- as.character(sd[ord, id_col])
  split <- sd[ord, split_col]
  stopifnot(nlevels(y) == 2, positive %in% levels(y))
 
  pool <- which(split %in% c("train", if (use_long) "long_train"))
  test <- which(split %in% "test")
  stopifnot(!any(ids[test] %in% ids[pool]),            # no subject in both sets
            !anyNA(y[c(pool, test)]))                  # the outcome is never imputed
 
  na_feat <- colSums(is.na(X[c(pool, test), , drop = FALSE]))
  if (any(na_feat > 0)) {
    stop("Missing values in: ", paste(names(na_feat)[na_feat > 0], collapse = ", "),
         " -- run impute_ps() first")
  }
 
  ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = cv_folds, allowParallel = FALSE,
                       sampling = sampling)
 
  # iterations run in parallel when n_cores > 1 (forked processes; macOS/Linux).
  # Each iteration sets its own seed, so results are identical for any n_cores.
  res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(n_iter), mc.cores = n_cores, FUN = function(i) {
    set.seed(seed + i)
 
    # one sample per subject (only matters when long_train samples are included)
    tr <- unlist(lapply(split(pool, ids[pool]), function(k) k[sample.int(length(k), 1)]))
    tr <- tr[createDataPartition(y[tr], p = p, list = FALSE)]
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ids[tr]))
 
    fit  <- train(x = X[tr, , drop = FALSE], y = y[tr], method = "rf",
                  metric = "Accuracy", trControl = ctrl)
    pred <- predict(fit, X[test, , drop = FALSE])
 
    truth <- y[test] == positive
    called <- pred == positive
    tp <- sum(called & truth);  tn <- sum(!called & !truth)
    fp <- sum(called & !truth); fn <- sum(!called & truth)
 
    # = varImp(fit, scale = FALSE), but keeps feature names when there is only one
    imp <- randomForest::importance(fit$finalModel)[features, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
 
    list(
      metrics = data.frame(model     = model_name,
                           iteration = i,
                           accuracy  = (tp + tn) / length(test),
                           f1        = 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn),
                           sens      = tp / (tp + fn),
                           spec      = tn / (tn + fp),
                           mcc       = (tp * tn - fp * fn) /
                                       sqrt(as.numeric(tp + fp) * (tp + fn) * (tn + fp) * (tn + fn))),
      importance = data.frame(model = model_name, iteration = i,
                              t(setNames(imp, features)),
                              check.names = FALSE)
    )
  })
  failed <- vapply(res, inherits, logical(1), "try-error")   # errors in workers come back as values
  if (any(failed)) stop("Iteration ", which(failed)[1], " failed: ", res[[which(failed)[1]]])
  list(metrics    = do.call(rbind, lapply(res, `[[`, "metrics")),
       importance = do.call(rbind, lapply(res, `[[`, "importance")))
}

compare_gut <- function(ps, baseline, gut, name, positive,
                        out_dir = "~/Downloads",
                        feature_labels = c(apoe4_carriage  = "APOE4 carriage",
                                           guild_abundance = "Guild Abundance",
                                           log2_NGAL       = "NGAL",
                                           log2_Calp       = "Calprotectin",
                                           Years_Education = "Years of Education"),
                        vars = c(Accuracy = "accuracy", Sensitivity = "sens",
                                 Specificity = "spec"),
                        p_show = 0.1, palette = "Glacier", show = TRUE, ...) {
 
  gut <- setdiff(gut, baseline)
  if (!length(gut)) stop("`gut` has no features that aren't already in `baseline`")
  slug <- gsub("^_|_$", "", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", name))   # safe for files / model names
  if (!is.null(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
  designs <- c(CS = "Cross-sectional", long = "Longitudinal")
  sets    <- list(gut = c(baseline, gut), nogut = baseline)
  set_lab <- c(gut = "Gut", nogut = "No gut")
 
  # ---- train the four models -------------------------------------------------
  # order: gut CS, gut long, nogut CS, nogut long
  grid <- expand.grid(design = names(designs), set = names(sets), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  grid$model <- paste0(slug, "_", grid$set, "_rf_", grid$design)
  models <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(j) {
    message("Training ", grid$model[j])
    run_rf(ps, sets[[grid$set[j]]], model_name = grid$model[j], positive = positive,
           use_long = grid$design[j] == "long", ...)
  }), grid$model)
 
  metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, `[[`, "metrics"))
  rownames(metrics) <- NULL
  metrics$design <- grid$design[match(metrics$model, grid$model)]
  metrics$set    <- grid$set[match(metrics$model, grid$model)]
 
  summ <- aggregate(cbind(accuracy, f1, sens, spec, mcc) ~ model, metrics,
                    function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), na.action = na.pass)
  summ <- summ[match(grid$model, summ$model), ]
  rownames(summ) <- NULL
 
  # ---- box plots + ANOVA / Tukey, one figure per design ----------------------
  fills <- as.character(unclass(natparks.pals(palette, n = 2, type = "discrete")))
  plots <- list(); anova_l <- list(); tukey_l <- list()
 
  for (d in names(designs)) {
    dd   <- metrics[metrics$design == d, ]
    long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(vars), function(v)
      data.frame(group = set_lab[dd$set], metric = v, value = dd[[vars[[v]]]])))
    long$group  <- factor(long$group, levels = set_lab)
    long$metric <- factor(long$metric, levels = names(vars))
 
    st <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(long$metric), function(m) {
      fit <- aov(value ~ group, data = long[long$metric == m, ])
      tk  <- TukeyHSD(fit)$group[1, ]                     # the single pair, "No gut-Gut"
      data.frame(design = d, metric = m,
                 p_anova = summary(fit)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1],
                 group1 = set_lab[["gut"]], group2 = set_lab[["nogut"]],
                 diff = tk[["diff"]], ci_low = tk[["lwr"]], ci_high = tk[["upr"]],
                 p_tukey = tk[["p adj"]])
    }))
    st$stars <- as.character(cut(st$p_tukey, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
                                 labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns"), right = FALSE))
    anova_l[[d]] <- data.frame(design = d, metric = st$metric, p = st$p_anova)
    tukey_l[[d]] <- st[, c("design", "metric", "group1", "group2", "diff",
                           "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_tukey", "stars")]
 
    # bracket when Tukey p < p_show; y-axis follows the data, spacing scales with it
    br   <- st[!is.na(st$p_tukey) & st$p_tukey < p_show, ]
    br$metric <- factor(br$metric, levels = levels(long$metric))
    br$x1 <- rep(1, nrow(br)); br$x2 <- rep(2, nrow(br))
    rng  <- diff(range(long$value, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (!is.finite(rng) || rng == 0) rng <- 0.1
    step <- 0.1 * rng
    top  <- tapply(long$value, long$metric, max, na.rm = TRUE)
    br$y <- top[as.character(br$metric)] + step
    ylims <- c(min(long$value, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.05 * rng,
               max(c(long$value, br$y), na.rm = TRUE) + step * 1.6)   # room for the stars
 
    p <- ggplot(long, aes(group, value, fill = group)) +
      geom_boxplot(colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.6, width = 0.75,
                   outlier.colour = "grey20", outlier.size = 2.2) +
      geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y - step / 6),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y - step / 6),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_text(data = br, aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y, label = stars),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, vjust = 0.35) +
      facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = length(vars)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fills) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = ylims, expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Metric Value", title = paste0(name, ": ", designs[[d]])) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
      theme(legend.position  = "none",
            panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
            axis.line        = element_blank(),
            strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            strip.text       = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
            axis.text        = element_text(colour = "grey25", size = 11),
            axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 12),
            axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 14),
            plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            panel.spacing    = unit(0.8, "lines"))
 
    plots[[d]] <- p
    if (!is.null(out_dir))
      ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(slug, "_", d, ".pdf")), p,
             width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 900)
  }
  anova <- do.call(rbind, anova_l); tukey <- do.call(rbind, tukey_l)
  rownames(anova) <- rownames(tukey) <- NULL
 
  # ---- feature importance, all four models -----------------------------------
  # long format: one row per model x iteration x feature
  imp_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) {
    imp   <- m$importance
    feats <- setdiff(names(imp), c("model", "iteration"))
    data.frame(model      = imp$model[1],
               feature    = rep(feats, each = nrow(imp)),
               importance = unlist(imp[feats], use.names = FALSE))
  }))
 
  # mean and SD over iterations (namespaced, so objects named `sd`/`mean` can't mask them)
  imp_sum <- merge(
    aggregate(importance ~ model + feature, imp_long, base::mean),
    setNames(aggregate(importance ~ model + feature, imp_long, stats::sd),
             c("model", "feature", "sd"))
  )
 
  # sort within each model: a model-specific key keeps each panel's order independent
  imp_sum     <- imp_sum[order(imp_sum$model, imp_sum$importance), ]
  imp_sum$key <- factor(paste(imp_sum$model, imp_sum$feature, sep = "___"),
                        levels = paste(imp_sum$model, imp_sum$feature, sep = "___"))
 
  model_labels  <- setNames(paste0(set_lab[grid$set], " features (", designs[grid$design], ")"),
                            grid$model)
  imp_sum$panel <- factor(model_labels[imp_sum$model], levels = model_labels)
  y_labels <- setNames(ifelse(imp_sum$feature %in% names(feature_labels),
                              feature_labels[imp_sum$feature], imp_sum$feature),
                       as.character(imp_sum$key))
 
  p_imp <- ggplot(imp_sum, aes(x = importance, y = key)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = pmax(importance - sd, 0),   # Gini importance can't go below 0
                      xmax = importance + sd), width = 0.3) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labels) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(x = expression("Mean decrease in Gini (mean" %+-% " SD across iterations)"), y = NULL,
         title = paste0(name, ": random forest feature importance")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
 
  plots$importance <- p_imp
  if (!is.null(out_dir))
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(slug, "_rf_feature_importance.pdf")), p_imp,
           width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 900)
 
  # the numbers behind the plot, most important first within each model
  imp_tab <- imp_sum[order(imp_sum$model, -imp_sum$importance),
                     c("model", "feature", "importance", "sd")]
  rownames(imp_tab) <- NULL
 
  out <- list(models = models, metrics = metrics, summary = summ,
              anova = anova, tukey = tukey, importance = imp_tab, plots = plots)
 
  # keep results on disk before anything is displayed, so nothing after this can lose them
  if (!is.null(out_dir)) saveRDS(out, file.path(out_dir, paste0(slug, "_results.rds")))
 
  # display last, and only warn on failure: RStudio's inline notebook output can fail
  # ("unable to open file ... _rs_chunk_plot", "gzfile ... cannot open the connection")
  if (show) tryCatch({
    for (d in names(designs)) {
      print(plots[[d]])
      print(anova[anova$design == d, ])
      print(tukey[tukey$design == d, ])
    }
    print(p_imp)
  }, error = function(e) warning(
    "Couldn't display results here (", conditionMessage(e), "). Everything is in the ",
    "returned list; show it from a new chunk, e.g. x$plots$CS", call. = FALSE))
 
  invisible(out)
}

```

Plot inclusion matrix: Figure 4A
```{r}
########################### Plot model feature details ################################
covariates <- c("Age", "Sex", "Education (years)", "BMI", "Hypertension", "Diabetes", "APOE e4", "WMH volume", "Hippocampus volume","Cortical signature","Calprotectin","NGAL","Guild abundance")

models <- c("CG", "CG + Gut", "CG_neuro", "CG_neuro + Gut")

matrix <- read_excel("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/2026_JianMark_ADGutOmics2/NatAging_Submission/Figures/Figure4/261028_ML_model_var_inclusion_matrix.xlsx")

# Define x- and y-axis model order
y_order <- covariates
x_order <- models

# Define covariate variable colors
cov_colors <- c(
  rep("black", 6),         # demographic and clinical covariates
  rep("#6B7F7F", 1),        # Genetic risk factors
  rep("#7F4B89", 3),        # Neurodegeneration and injury
  rep("#CB7223", 2),        # Stool inflammation
  rep("#289A84", 1)       # Selected taxa
)
names(cov_colors) <- y_order

# Turn labels into HTML with color
y_labels_colored <- paste0(
  "<span style='color:", cov_colors, ";'><b>", y_order, "</b></span>"
)
names(y_labels_colored) <- y_order

# Covert to long format for plotting
df_long <- matrix %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = x_order)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Model,
    names_to = "Covariate",
    values_to = "Included"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Covariate = factor(Covariate, levels = y_order),
    Included = as.numeric(Included)
  )
library(ggtext)

## Create separator positions
# Horizontal lines (between covariates)
h_lines <- seq(0.5, length(y_order) + 0.5, 1)
# Vertical lines (between models)
v_lines <- seq(0.5, length(x_order) + 0.5, 1)

p_incl <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Model, y = Covariate, fill = Included)) +
  geom_tile(color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#bfc7d6") +  
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labels_colored) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.6,
                               color = "black", face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = h_lines, color = "black", linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = v_lines, color = "black", linewidth = 1)

ggsave(filename="261028_ML_CS_model_inclusion_variables.pdf", plot = p_incl, width = 3, height = 5)
```
